semantics.concepts: Lexical themes matched in each displayed term; first matching theme supplies its colour. These are not inferred methods or semantic clusters.
semantics.rare: Exactly one occurrence in the selected source text, in one selected paper.
semantics.single_paper: More than one occurrence, all in one selected paper. This is not a single-occurrence rare term.
semantics.unusual: Not found in the available comparison text outside this scope, at least two scoped occurrences, and smoothed log-odds at least 1. This describes this library, not scientific novelty.
semantics.comparison: Uses the same selected source (abstracts or indexed full text) for the scope and the rest of the library. Missing source text is not evidence of absence in a paper.
